kbmi.loc: AR2025 PDF p. 502 (printed p. 500), Tabel Pengungkapan Risiko - Key Metrics: 'Modal Inti (Tier 1)' Rp6,389,985 juta at 31 Dec 2025
kbmi.note: Derived from the regulation, not stated by the bank: no AR sentence states Bank Jago's KBMI tier. Tier 1 capital of Rp6.39tn is within the KBMI 2 band (Rp6tn to below Rp14tn, POJK 12/POJK.03/2021). AR2022 (PDF p. 44) and AR2023 (PDF p. 80) benchmark Bank Jago against 'KBMI 2' banks. Tier 1 was Rp6.70tn at end-2024 and Rp6,392,773 juta at 30 Sep 2026 (published report), i.e. only ~6.5% above the KBMI 1/2 boundary.

validation_ack.reason: Rights issue II (3,000,000,000 new shares, ex-date 5 Mar 2021, listed 10 Mar 2021) means FY2021 basic EPS Rp6.48 is computed on weighted-average shares of 13,277,410,898 (audited FS2021 Note 28, PDF p. 77: 86,024 / 13,277,410,898 = 6.48), while shares_out is the year-end 13,856,250,000. The ~4.4% gap is real, not a data error.

Rights issue I (1 old : 8 new, 9,650,000,000 new shares listed 2 Apr 2020) means the FY2020 basic loss per share of Rp(22.49) is computed on weighted-average shares of 8,430,566,940 (audited FS2021 Note 28 comparative, PDF p. 77: (189,567) / 8,430,566,940 = (22.49)), while shares_out is the year-end 10,856,250,000. The ~29% gap is real (loss year).

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: www.jago.com (and its IR pages under /id/transparency/hubungan-investor) is behind a Cloudflare block for this server; no challenge was bypassed. All PDFs were downloaded DIRECTLY from the bank's own asset host https://assets.jago.com/web-assets/public/ (a public file host that is not blocked). File names for 2025/2026 documents were found via web search and the Internet Archive CDX index of assets.jago.com, plus a few HEAD requests for the bank's established naming pattern. Only HTML pages and logo files from www.jago.com were read through Internet Archive snapshots (see sources.md).

ENTITY / BASIS: PT Bank Jago Tbk (formerly PT Bank Artos Indonesia Tbk, renamed in 2020; ticker ARTO since the 12 Jan 2016 IPO). Bank Jago has NO subsidiaries, so its (entity) financial statements are the whole group: money figures are stored with basis 'consolidated' as SCHEMA rule 3 requires, ratios with basis 'bank_only' as reported to OJK. Jago Syariah is a sharia business unit (UUS) inside the bank, not a subsidiary; sharia=false (conventional bank).

DEPOSITS: fy.*.deposits = 'Dana Pihak Ketiga' printed in each AR's Ikhtisar Keuangan, which includes temporary syirkah funds (Jago Syariah mudharabah deposits; AR2021 footnote '* Termasuk Dana Syirkah Temporer'). The audited FS present syirkah funds outside liabilities and print no DPK total. Checks: FY2024 5,095,861 + 4,862,006 + 8,640,542 + 207,421 = 18,805,830; FY2025 4,875,714 + 7,971,747 + 12,749,872 + 301,158 = 25,898,491. LDR and CASA in the AR use the same DPK. loans_gross includes sharia financing (FY2021 sharia financing was 2,047,853 of 5,368,954).

LOSS YEARS: FY2019 (loss 121,966, Bank Artos) and FY2020 (loss 189,567) are real losses; FY2020 EPS, ROA (-11.27), ROE (-18.03), BOPO (261.1) and CIR (357.4) are negative/extreme by nature. Seven values sit outside the validator's plausibility ranges and are REAL, not unit slips (validator not changed): FY2020 ROA -11.27 (range [-10,10]), CoC 10.1 ([-2,10]), CIR 357.4 ([0,150]), BOPO 261.1 ([0,200]), CAR 91.38 ([5,80]); FY2021 CAR 169.92 and FY2022 CAR 82.75 (excess capital from the rights issues). Profits since 2021 are small (ROE 0.2-4.3%) because equity is large after the rights issues (CAR 169.9% in 2021).

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-03: two rights issues only - PMHMETD I (1:8 at Rp139, ex 30 Mar 2020) and PMHMETD II (579:160 at Rp2,350, ex 5 Mar 2021). NO stock split, reverse split or bonus issue: nominal value has been Rp100 since the IPO (AR2025 PDF p. 93 listing chronology; FS 9M2026 PDF p. 5), so no per-share adjustment applies to any figure. Other share changes are NOT rights/bonus issues and are not in corporate_actions: MESOP option exercises (761,200 shares in Jun-Jul 2024 and 4,319,700 in Dec 2024-Jan 2025 at Rp2,150; AR2025 PDF p. 93) took shares from 13,856,250,000 to 13,861,330,900; a new MESOP 2025-2030 programme (capital increase without pre-emptive rights) was approved in 2025 (AR2025 PDF p. 214). Gojek (PT Dompet Karya Anak Bangsa) became a shareholder in Dec 2020 by buying existing shares, not through a placement. AR2022 states no corporate actions in 2022; AR2025 states no buyback in 2025.

SHARE COUNTS / EPS: year-end shares from the FS share-capital line (FY2021, 2023-2025) or the AR share table (FY2020, FY2022); no treasury shares in any year. EPS x shares matches profit within 0.1% for FY2022-FY2025; FY2020 and FY2021 differ because of the rights issues (weighted-average shares 8,430,566,940 and 13,277,410,898; see validation_ack). share_basis = period end everywhere (no split ever, so the adjuster factor is 1).

DIVIDENDS: none. Bank Jago has never paid a dividend out of FY2020-FY2025 profit; dividends: [] and payout_ratio v=0 each year with the AR/AGMS source. Reason: accumulated deficit until end-2024 (Rp36.19bn) plus the Rights Issue II prospectus policy of no dividends for 2020-2023. FY2025 is the first year with positive retained earnings (240,044 at 1 Jan 2026), but the AGMS of 7 May 2026 approved no cash dividend (9M2026 statement of changes in equity shows none; news cross-check in the FY2025 payout note).

RATIO SOURCES: FY2021-FY2025 ratios come from the AR2025 'Rasio Keuangan (%)' table (latest AR, one consistent series; identical to the OJK published December reports for FY2024/FY2025). FY2020 ratios come from AR2023 (latest AR that prints FY2020; identical to AR2020-AR2022). The only series that changed between ARs is NPL coverage ('CKPN terhadap NPL'): AR2025 prints 415.84/161.01/223.45/1,023.71 for 2021-2024, AR2024 printed 409.83/157.91/221.37/996.82 - AR2025 values stored, old values in each note; reason not explained. CoC ('Cost of Credit/Avg. Loan') and LAR are not in the AR tables; they come from the analyst decks (FY25, FY24, FY23, FY22 and 3Q21 decks), rounded to 1 decimal. FY2020 LAR is not disclosed (null).

YEAR-END PRICES: Q4 'Penutupan' from each AR's share table: 3,100 (2019, AR2019, close dated 30 Dec 2019 = pre-rights-issue-I anchor; share_basis 2020-04-16 = AR2019 PDF date), 4,300 (2020), 16,000 (2021), 3,720 (2022), 2,900 (2023), 2,430 (2024), 1,975 (2025); each confirmed by the next AR. AR2020-AR2022 tables show 'high/low' values that look like last-session values rather than quarterly ranges - only the closing column is used. These should be checked against prices/ARTO.json when it is generated (no price file existed at research time).

INTERIM = 9M 2026 (30 Sep 2026): unaudited FS authorised 28 Oct 2026 (profit, equity, assets, loans, shares), the OJK-format published report of the same date (ROE, ROA, NIM, NPL, KKR/LAR, LDR, CAR, CIR) and the 9M 2026 analyst deck (deposits, prior-year loans/deposits, CoC, CASA). Deposits/prior balances use the deck because no filing prints the totals (FS components match). NPL coverage for 9M2026 is not disclosed (null). 9M2026 profit Rp298.1bn (+49.7% YoY).

RESTATEMENTS / MINOR: the 9M2026 FS shows the 31 Dec 2025 total assets as 36,507,294 vs 36,507,347 in the audited FY2025 FS and AR2025 (Rp53m reclassification between assets and liabilities); fy.2025 keeps the audited figure. FY2019 EPS was printed (97.19) in AR2019 and (101.11) in AR2020 (reclassified, AR2020 Note 45); FY2019 needs no EPS here. AR2021 printed FY2021 other operating income 44,129; later ARs print 55,691 (reclassification; not stored). AR2024 gives two AGMS dates for 2024 (25 May on PDF p. 109, 22 May on PDF p. 178).

REBRAND: Bank Jago and Jago Syariah adopted a simplified new logo effective 11 Jun 2026 (news of the bank's disclosure; website logo files 'logo-jago-re.svg' / 'logo-jago-syariah-re.svg' first archived Jun-Aug 2026; the 30 Sep 2026 published report and 9M26 deck use the new logo, AR2025 and the Dec 2025 report the old one). No change of legal name or ticker. See logo/SOURCE.md.
SHAREHOLDERS (AR2025 PDF p. 92, Dec 2025): PT Metamorfosis Ekosistem Indonesia 29.79%, PT Dompet Karya Anak Bangsa (GoTo) 21.40%, Wealth Track Technology 11.68%, GIC 9.02%, public 28.11%.
